<thought>Based on the mass spectrum, the molecular ion shows a prominent M+2 peak at ~33 % intensity, characteristic of a single chlorine atom. The exact mass of the M peak (≈183.045 Da) together with the chlorine isotope pattern suggests a formula consistent with a chloronitro‑benzene (C₈H₆ClNO₂). The SMILES for 4‑chloronitrobenzene (or any monochloro‑nitrobenzene isomer) is “Clc1ccc(cc1)[N+](=O)[O-]”, which is a valid SMILES string.</thought>
<final_answer>Clc1ccc(cc1)[N+](=O)[O-]</final_answer>
